description: HR-97 is the Regional Transport Office serving the Ladwa sub-division in the Kurukshetra district of Haryana. Established to decentralize transport services, it operates under the SDO (Civil) as the Registering Authority for motor vehicles. It handles registration series HR-97, driving licenses, and local transport taxation.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Ladwa, District Kurukshetra, Haryana
